flavor.phonemic_palette: Classic Maya backbone (glottalized b'/t'/k'/tz'/ch'; x = sh; aj-/ix- agentives; -aj/-ab endings) with a Woodland overlay (the labial-free Iroquoian register; long -onon/-wenne compounds in the forest substrate); theophoric on the Maya morphs (Tulax-, Marakab-) with Woodland variants (Tularonon-, Waraksonon-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Mayan + Woodland per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Mayan + Woodland register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'tikan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Tikan — wary theocratic of the jungle; tradition, knowledge.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Tikan (Mayan + Woodland) are a defensive theocratic people seeded in jungle, dense forest, mountains. They prize tradition, knowledge, piety, lean toward the military sphere, and field light_infantry, archers, militia. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch harvest, wisdom, nature.
